definitions.order_sensitive_hyperedge: Exactly one of a->b->c and b->a->c is accepted.
definitions.order_insensitive_hyperedge: Both a->b->c and b->a->c are accepted.
definitions.convergent_commuting_hyperedge: Both orders are accepted and the two pre-target prefix residual hashes are identical.
definitions.incidence_graph: For every unlock hyperedge {a,b}->c add directed edges a->c and b->c.
definitions.condensation_depth: Maximum number of SCC nodes on a directed path in the SCC condensation DAG; isolated involved SCC counts as depth 1.

decision_order: If the complete hyperedge set contains only the already sealed {11,12}->15 edge, classify NO_ADDITIONAL_MINIMAL_TWO_KEY_UNLOCKS_BEYOND_SEALED_EDGE.
Else if order_sensitive_hyperedge_count>0 and order_insensitive_hyperedge_count==0, classify RIGID_ORDER_SENSITIVE_SERIAL_SIGNAL.
Else if order_sensitive_hyperedge_count>0 and order_insensitive_hyperedge_count>0, classify MIXED_ORDER_SENSITIVE_AND_COMMUTING_UNLOCK_STRUCTURE.
Else all hyperedges are order-insensitive. If condensation_depth<=2 OR largest_SCC_size==involved_node_count, classify COMMUTING_UNLOCK_HYPERGRAPH_RAPIDLY_COLLAPSES.
